rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING THE GREEN CORRIDOR INITIATIVE FOR TOURISM AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Defines Green Corridor Initiative as any tourism program and activity spearheaded by local government units, in collaboration with the State and private stakeholders: that shall ensure and promote regional biodiversity, improve environmental quality, offer economic resilience opportunities, protect heritage and culture, and support the jumpstart of the economy in the new normal.
Tasks the DOT in coordination with the DILG, DENR, and DOH to create the operational guidelines of the Green Corridor Initiative in adherence to the principles and objectives of the Tourism Act of 2009 (R.A. No.9593).

rows.title_full:
AN ACT
CREATING A SUSTAINABLE FISCAL FRAMEWORK FOR THE
PENSION SYSTEM OF THE MILITARY AND UNIFORMED PERSONNEL, PROVIDING MECHANISMS FOR THE DISPOSITION OF GOVERNMENT ASSETS FOR THE PURPOSE, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Military And Uniformed Personnel Pension Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to secure the pension system for the military and uniformed personnel that shall ensure an adequate, robust, and a well-managed insurance system that shall adequately and sustainably support their needs and that of their dependents.

Proposes the following reforms to sustain the pension system: 1. The amount of One Hundred Thirty Billion Pesos (P130,000,000,000.00) shall be appropriated to the MUP Trust Fund to cover the pension requirement of the Fiscal Year for which the fund was appropriated. 2. Making mandatory for military and uniformed personnel to contribute to a percentage of their monthly compensation as their personal share to the MUP Trust Fund and there shall also be a share of the National Government which shall be automatically appropriated and exclusively used to fund pension benefits of the military and uniformed personnel; and 3. Proceeds from the sale /lease of MUP assets, and other identified assets, will be sources of additional funding.

Exempts the MUP trust Fund, its assets, revenues, including all accruals thereto, and benefits paid, from all taxes, assessments, fees, charges, or duties of all kinds which shall continue unless expressly and specifically revoked.

rows.author: I051
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7305, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE MAGNA CARTA OF PUBLIC HEALTH WORKERS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Provides that there shall be no discrimination against a public health worker concerning his SEXUAL ORIENTATION AND gender IDENTITY, civil status, AGE, DISABILITY, religious or political beliefs, AND AFFILIATIONS, OR ETHNICITY in the exercise of his profession.
Seeks to amend the existing law to assist and protect our public health workers, and ensure that they are appropriately compensated and provided with their well-deserved incentives and benefits as follows:  Night Shift Differential of TWENTY (20%) of his regular wage for each hour of work;  an additional TWENTY (20%) of an overtime rate for each hour of work performed between SIX (6) o´clock in the evening to six (6) o´clock in the morning; Monthly Hazard Allowance of TEN THOUSAND PESOS (P10,000.00); Subsistence Allowance equivalent to THREE HUNDRED PESOS (P300.00) per day; and Laundry Allowance to FIVE HUNDRED PESOS (P500.00)  per month.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2021-07-28
